Privacy Policy 2026

Your privacy is important to us at BuySmart AI. This policy outlines how we handle your data in the year 2026 and beyond.

1. Data Collection

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, save products, or set price alerts. This includes your name, email, and preferences.

2. AI Data Usage

Our AI models analyze your shopping behavior to provide personalized recommendations and predict price drops. This data is processed securely and is never sold to third parties.

3. Real-time Monitoring

To provide accurate price alerts, we monitor prices across multiple platforms in real-time. Your target prices are stored securely in our cloud database.

4. Your Rights

You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through the app settings.

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to BuySmart AI. By using our application, you agree to the following terms:

1. Use of Service

You agree to use BuySmart AI only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others.

2. Pricing Accuracy

While we strive for 100% accuracy, prices across e-commerce platforms change rapidly. BuySmart AI is not responsible for discrepancies between our predicted prices and actual checkout prices.

3. Account Security

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password.

4. AI Recommendations

Our AI "Buy/Wait" recommendations are based on historical data patterns and should be used as a helpful guide, not as guaranteed financial advice.

About BuySmart AI

BuySmart AI is the world\'s most advanced AI-powered shopping assistant, launched in 2024 and revolutionized in 2026.

Our mission is to help you save money and time by using cutting-edge machine learning to predict price drops, find hidden coupons, and compare millions of products across the web in milliseconds.

Developed by a team of shopping experts and AI researchers, BuySmart is your ultimate companion for the modern e-commerce era.

Help & Support

Need assistance? We\'re here to help you shop smarter!

Common Questions:

  • How do Price Alerts work? - Click the bell icon on any product. When the price hits your target, we\'ll send a push notification.
  • How does Auto-Coupon work? - Add items to your cart. Our AI automatically scans and applies the best working code at checkout.
  • Is my data safe? - Yes, we use 256-bit encryption for all your profile and preference data.

For further support, email us at: support@buysmart.ai
